title: Moody’s pegs India’s FY27 GDP growth at 7%, aided by robust consumption, investment

ai.summary: Moody's Ratings revised India's FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7% from 6.5%, citing robust consumption, improving investment, and strong macroeconomic fundamentals, though near-term risks include inflation and monsoon conditions.

facts.claim: Moody's Ratings revised India's FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7% from 6.5%
facts.quote: Moody’s Ratings on Wednesday said the Indian economy is expected to grow at 7 per cent in the current fiscal compared to 6.5 per cent pegged earlier

facts.claim: Robust consumption, improving investment dynamics and strong macroeconomic fundamentals
facts.quote: robust consumption, improving investment dynamics and strong macroeconomic fundamentals imply that the economy appears well positioned to sustain growth near 7 per cent over the medium term

facts.claim: Retail inflation rose to 5.54 per cent in September 2026
facts.quote: Retail inflation rose to 5.54 per cent in September 2026

facts.claim: RBI estimates GDP growth of 7.1 per cent in the current fiscal
facts.quote: RBI estimates GDP growth of 7.1 per cent in the current fiscal, in line with OECD projection

facts.claim: IMF, ADB and S&P Global Ratings have projected a 7 per cent growth
facts.quote: The International Monetary Fund (IMF), ADB and S&P Global Ratings have projected a 7 per cent growth

facts.claim: Fitch Ratings expects India’s GDP to grow 6.9 per cent
facts.quote: Fitch Ratings expects India’s GDP to grow 6.9 per cent
